=segments.text: Once upon a time, big golden bosses told their glowing workers and lizard soldiers to build tall towers in special places.
But those places were already homes for giant rock people and little light creatures.
The rock people didn’t want the towers—they kept fixing the ground when the workers messed it up.
The lizard soldiers got mean and started fighting them.
The glowing workers felt bad but couldn’t stop because the golden bosses controlled their brains.
Now everyone is sad and fighting, and the towers keep growing where they don’t belong.
